# pve_vm_start (Action)

Start a VM.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_vm_start" "example" {
  config {
  node = "pve1"
  vmid = 100
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_vm_start.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.

### Optional

- `force_cpu` (String) Override QEMU's -cpu argument with the given string.
- `machine` (String) Specify the QEMU machine.
- `migratedfrom` (String) The cluster node name.
- `migration_network` (String) CIDR of the (sub) network that is used for migration.
- `migration_type` (String) Migration traffic is encrypted using an SSH tunnel by default. On secure, completely private networks this can be disabled to increase performance. One of: `secure`, `insecure`.
- `nets_host_mtu` (String) Used for migration compat. List of VirtIO network devices and their effective host_mtu setting according to the QEMU object model on the source side of the migration. A value of 0 means that the host_mtu parameter is to be avoided for the corresponding device.
- `skiplock` (Boolean) Ignore locks - only root is allowed to use this option.
- `stateuri` (String) Some command save/restore state from this location.
- `targetstorage` (String) Mapping from source to target storages. Providing only a single storage ID maps all source storages to that storage. Providing the special value '1' will map each source storage to itself.
- `timeout` (Number) Wait maximal timeout seconds. (default: max(30, vm memory in GiB))
- `with_conntrack_state` (Boolean) Whether to migrate conntrack entries for running VMs. (default: 0)
